sources.title: The Game Awards 2026 Nominations Revealed, GTA 6 Dominates
sources.text: The 2026 Game Award nominations have finally been revealed. This is arguably one of the biggest years in gaming, as it has featured some of the hottest, most anticipated games out there. We got the long-awaited return of Leon Kennedy in Resident Evil Requiem, the release of 007 First Light, which fans had been waiting for since 2020, and, of course, the launch of GTA 6. With the year coming to an end, The Game Awards has revealed the nominees for 2026 ahead of the ceremony on December 10. As you might have predicted, GTA 6 swept with eight nominations, including the coveted Game of the Year. Yes, we really got GTA 6 nominated for Game of the Year before GTA 6. There's it's competing with 007 First Light, Control Resonant, Phantom Blade Zero, Resident Evil Requiem, and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake for the main award. The Game Awards 2026 nominations also confirms, finally, the actor who plays Lucia in GTA 6 . Manni L. Perez, who many fans had suspected played Lucia in Rockstar's game, is nominated in the Best Performance category. The actor who plays fellow GTA 6 protagonist Jason doesn't make the cut. Nintendo is The Game Awards’ most nominated publisher in 2026 with 12 nominations across its combined portfolio, followed by Capcom with 11 nominations, and Annapurna Interactive and PlayStation with nine nominations each. The Best Adaptation award includes noms for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2, Fallout Season 2, Mortal Kombat II, The Super Mario Galaxy Movie, and Resident Evil. sources.title: GTA 6 Fans Baffled After Jason's Actor Gets Left Out of Game Awards Nominations
sources.text: GTA 6 fans are a bit surprised that the actor playing Jason wasn't nominated at The Game Awards. Earlier today, The Game Awards gave us our first indicator of how GTA 6 will be received. It's up for eight awards, including Game of the Year . It was a bit odd, as there are no reviews for the game at the moment, but the jury clearly deemed it worthwhile. The other notable thing to come out of the Game Awards nominations was that it confirmed the actress for Lucia: Manni L. Perez . Fans have speculated she was Lucia for years now, but now it's confirmed, as she was nominated for Best Performance. However, the actor who plays the game's other protagonist was not nominated. Fans were taken aback, since the two are clearly a package deal in the game, and one has to imagine they elevate each other. However, the jury must not have felt strongly enough about Jason to give his actor the nomination. There's no rule against nominating multiple actors for a single project, either. Last year, three performers from Expedition 33 were all nominated in the same category, after all. Jason has been seen as a much more subtle and reserved character compared to Lucia. He's a bit quieter, isn't too flashy with his actions, and maybe lacks the fire in his character compared to someone like Lucia. One fan on Reddit noted that Jason didn't make a strong impression on them in any of the trailers: "Honestly, I'm not a fan of his VO," they said . "Jason doesn't sound good, at least in the footage we saw; he lacks diction. Most of the time, I can't understand what he's saying without subs." However, another fan pushed back, noting that other great Rockstar actors have been snubbed in the past: "Benjamin Byron Davis wasn't nominated for his Dutch performance [in Red Dead Redemption 2]," they said . "Didn't take away one bit and [it's] arguably the best performance in the game." It's certainly a valid point, especially since Rob Wiethoff also wasn't nominated for his role as John Marston in Red Dead Redemption 2, despite being a secondary protagonist. As of right now, we're not sure who is playing Jason, but it won't be long before we find out. GTA 6 will officially go live tomorrow morning in select regions, as the game becomes available in New Zealand . It'll be interesting to see which of the two protagonists fans end up gravitating toward more in the end, but it seems like Lucia may be a favorite based on her nomination. sources.text: Manni L. Perez has been confirmed as the actress behind Grand Theft Auto 6 's Lucia Caminos, just days before the game launches. As spotted by IGN , the confirmation came during The Game Awards' nominations livestream today, where Perez was nominated for Best Performance for her role as co-lead Lucia. Perez had been widely rumoured to play Lucia for months, and fans have regularly filled her social media livestreams with questions about GTA 6, which she has been oh-so-carefully sidestepping. Lucia is one half of GTA 6's lead pair alongside Jason Duval, making it the first Grand Theft Auto game with a playable couple. Jason's actor wasn't among the nominees, so who plays him is still a mystery. Perez has previously had guest roles in a string of US TV dramas, including Law & Order: Special Victims Unit, Chicago P.D., The Blacklist, and Blindspot, and has also done voice work for GTA Online . Funnily enough, Lucia isn't her first Lucia - she also played Lucia Santiago in a 2023 episode of CBS's East New York. GTA 6 arrives 19th November on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. It is now available to pre-load for anyone who pre-ordered the digital version, and those with the code-in-box physical version. It's long been revealed that GTA 6 will have a regional release, meaning that some lucky, soon-to-be players will be able to access the game much earlier than others. Rockstar's regional release schedule sees the game launching at midnight on 19th November regardless of what region you're in, and if you wish to join those playing almost a day early, there's the good ol' Xbox New Zealand trick for eager players to try .

sources.title: 5 Big Takeaways From the 2026 Game Awards Nominations
sources.text: Led by GTA 6, the GOTY race retreats into its most conservative form in years Despite the dramatic timing — before Grand Theft Auto 6 's release, even before reviews for Rockstar's game have been published — nominations for The Game Awards 2026 weren't very surprising. This was always going to be GTA 6 's year. If there was one surprising thing, it's that, after what seemed to be an unpredictable run-up, the Game of the Year lineup was resolved in the most predictable way imaginable. We could have had Pokémon Pokopia , Big Walk , and Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave . Instead, we got yet more games made in GTA's image. Here are our five big takeaways from The Game Awards 2026. Ahead of reviews going live, The Game Awards' international jury of games media gave Grand Theft Auto 6 a resounding vote of confidence with eight nominations, including in Game of the Year. It's a preview of the wave of critical acclaim that's always been expected from a studio, Rockstar Games, whose last two games both achieved ratings of 97 on Metacritic. Eight nominations might not sound as overwhelming as the 13 secured by Clair Obscur: Expedition 3 last year. (Once the Players' Voice nominees are revealed, that number will surely go up to nine.) But the important thing is that GTA 6 secured a nomination in every single category it was reasonably eligible for, sweeping all the craft awards as well as getting into its genre category (Action/Adventure Game) and Game of the Year. The nods in the Best Narrative and Best Performance categories are particularly notable, indicating that GTA 6 has dramatic substance as well as technical virtuosity. Whether it will win every one of those categories is another matter, but it remains the overwhelming favorite for Game of the Year. The Game Awards has always been associated with its penchant for cinematic action-adventure games with slick production values. But recent years have seen much more diverse line-ups in Game of the Year. Since 2021, GOTY has been won by a family co-op game, a platformer, and three fairly hardcore RPGs. In 2024, three RPGs, one platformer, one action-adventure, and one indie card game were nominated. In 2025, it was two RPGs, two indie action games, one platformer and one action-adventure. In 2026, the field is five action-adventures and one action game that looks an awful lot like an action-adventure. They're not all from big publishers — three are self-published by the developers, an interesting trend — but they can all be reasonably described as AAA productions. This is a massive backward step for representation of the full breadth of what gaming can offer. This can't be laid entirely at the jury's door. It was a weak year for RPGs, and while there were excellent indie games, there were no breakout indie hits that grabbed widespread attention. But that just makes the lineup a demonstration of the flattened taste and lack of adventurousness of The Game Awards' large international jury . With six nominations, including Game Direction, Narrative, and Game of the Year, you would be forgiven for thinking that Control Resonant is a critical smash with a 90-plus Metacritic rating. In fact, it's quite divisive, and its Metacritic rating of 83 is at the lower end for a GOTY nominee. But The Game Awards jury just loves Remedy games. The original Control was nominated despite a Metascore of 82. The admittedly great Alan Wake 2 had eight nominations and won Best Game Direction and Best Narrative from under the noses of The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom and Baldur's Gate 3 . With the perfect combination of commercial production values, aspirational storytelling, and outsider cred, Remedy remains catnip for the jury. A weekly cheat sheet to what you’ll eventually love to play. No buying, no commitment — just saving for later. After an initial wave of hype, Crimson Desert 's GOTY hopes were dashed against the rocky shore of a distinctly mediocre critical reception. But the narrative that it remained a contender proved hard to shake, powered by a vocal fanbase and developer Pearl Abyss' relentless schedule of updates and improvements. Its one nomination for Best Community Support is fitting and well deserved. Crimson Desert might have been elbowed out of the running in other categories by Phantom Blade Zero , another ambitious game from an insurgent Asian developer, this one with better review scores. But striking out in all the craft categories and even Best Role-Playing Game — in a quiet year for RPGs — just shows how weak Crimson Desert really was in the eyes of The Game Awards jury. It's a vital reminder that The Game Awards are largely voted on by game reviewers, and if game reviewers don't like your game, you're toast. At The Game Awards, there are six nominees for Game of the Year and five for most other categories. Which ones? Well, that varies. This year, there were six nominees for Game for Impact, Best Action/Adventure Game, and Best Multiplayer Game. Last year, there were six nominees for Best Performance, Best Independent Game, Best Family Game, and Best Sim/Strategy Game. In 2023, it was Best Game Direction and Games for Impact. The reasoning is that this happens when there's a tie in the voting tabulation. That sounds fair enough, but really, The Game Awards needs to find a way to resolve such ties by changing its voting system (preferential ballots would be one option). Somehow, ties that might expand the fixed GOTY category are avoided. The loosey-goosey category limits undermine all aspects of the results, especially the total tallies of nominations attached to particular games or publishers. One reason Clair Obscur 's nominations record may never be beaten is that it had three Performance nominees in a field of six. That's not fair. The Game Awards needs to fix this.

sources.text: O Checkpoint desta terça-feira (17) chega com grandes novidades para os fãs de NBA e ansiosos por GTA 6 . NBA 2K27 receberá uma edição especial chamada Vice City , além de diversos itens temáticos do game da Rockstar na sua terceira temporada. Em outras notícias, dados divulgados pela agência Newzoo afirmam que as pré-encomendas de GTA 6 são de jogadores de console típicos e com alto poder aquisitivo, predominantemente homens — com a maioria já tendo um certo histórico de gastos com a franquia. Quer saber o que mais rolou no mundo dos games nesta terça (17)? Então prepara o cafezinho da tarde e acompanhe o VOXL por mais um Checkpoint ! NBA 2K27 receberá uma Edição Vice City e diversos conteúdos temáticos de GTA 6 a partir de 27 de novembro, com o início da Temporada 3. A atualização terá duração de sete semanas e incluirá mudanças no mapa, itens cosméticos, uniformes especiais e eventos inspirados no universo da Rockstar. Entre as novidades estão um Parque inspirado em Vice City, a troca da NBA Arena pela Sahara Arena e recompensas como roupas do Burger Shot e de Los Santos. A Take-Two também confirmou que a Edição Vice City , incluindo o Passe Pro da Temporada 3, estará disponível em todas as plataformas (PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2 e PC). Um levantamento da Newzoo aponta que a maioria das pessoas que reservaram GTA 6 é formada por homens que já gastaram dinheiro com a franquia. Segundo os dados, 52% dos consumidores que fizeram a pré-encomenda compraram GTA 5 ou GTA Online desde 2018. O perfil também indica que menos de 15% dos compradores antecipados são mulheres, proporção abaixo dos 27% registrados entre consumidores de jogos premium no mesmo período. Para Emmanuel Rosier, diretor de Inteligência de Mercado da Newzoo, o lançamento deve ampliar o mercado em vez de apenas redistribuir os gastos: “É provável que alguns jogadores estiquem seus orçamentos de jogos e comprem o jogo além do que normalmente gastariam em um ano”. A Nintendo disponibilizou uma demo gratuita de Splatoon Raiders na eShop do Switch 2, permitindo que os jogadores experimentem o spin-off antes de comprar o game. Lançado em julho deste ano, o título é uma experiência para um jogador que mistura mecânicas de tiro e coleta de recursos. A demonstração oferece três fases diferentes e permite escolher entre três conjuntos de equipamentos pré-selecionados. Segundo a Nintendo, as opções ajudam a mostrar como os dispositivos disponíveis podem alterar as estratégias usadas para concluir cada missão. O remake de The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time se tornou o jogo físico mais vendido dos EUA em 2026 até o momento, após ultrapassar 1 milhão de cópias apenas na primeira semana. Os dados foram divulgados por Mat Piscatella, diretor sênior da Circana, que também destacou que nenhum outro lançamento físico do ano alcançou esse volume no país. Segundo Piscatella, o título é o primeiro jogo desde The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom , em 2023, a vender mais de 1 milhão de unidades físicas nos EUA em uma única semana. O desempenho também acompanha o resultado global divulgado pela Nintendo, que registrou 5,2 milhões de cópias vendidas, somando versões físicas e digitais, nos primeiros quatro dias. O Metacritic removeu avaliações falsas de usuários de GTA 6 que foram publicadas antes mesmo do lançamento oficial do jogo, agendado para esta quinta (19). Algumas notas negativas chegaram a afetar temporariamente a pontuação do título na plataforma, apesar de os jogadores ainda não terem acesso à versão final. O site agiu rapidamente para excluir as avaliações e impedir novos envios antecipados. Normalmente, o Metacritic libera as notas dos usuários apenas 36 horas após a chegada de um jogo ao mercado, medida criada para evitar campanhas de review bomb feitas por pessoas que ainda não experimentaram o título. sources.title: First details on MLB The Show 27
sources.text: Includes the return of Now & Later Packs, MLB The Show 26 community stats, and more. Before we dive into new information on MLB The Show 27, let’s take a look back. As we reflect on 2026, two things stand out above everything else: the incredible passion and support of the MLB The Show community, and our need to better communicate and react to community feedback going forward. Whether you’ve been playing for decades or joined us for the first time this year, you’ve helped make this another special chapter in our franchise’s history. While we’re proud of what our team accomplished this year, we recognize that the heart of MLB The Show has always been its community. Since launch, you’ve hit an astonishing: You’ve also drawn 123,300,616 walks and racked up a staggering 2,130,551,161 strikeouts. It seems we have some work to do on our collective plate discipline and pitch recognition! But it’s not all strikeouts. You’ve also recorded 18,666,758 Perfect-Perfect hits and scored an incredible 2,506,757,548 runs. And if those numbers weren’t impressive enough, the community collectively spent the equivalent of 31,541 years playing MLB The Show this year. This year was not without some issues and hopefully over the next few months we’ll show you how we’ve made improvements in a host of areas.Your stories, feedback, creativity, and passion remind us why we do what we do. We don’t take your time, trust, or support for granted, and we’re incredibly fortunate to have a community that cares so deeply about the game. From all of us at San Diego Studio, thank you for another unforgettable year. We’re excited about what lies ahead and look forward to continuing this journey together. So, what lies ahead? We’re eager to share the exciting new features and improvements coming to MLB The Show 27, but it’s still a little too early to reveal what’s in store. However, there’s one announcement we can’t wait to make: The Tech Test is officially returning for MLB The Show 27. Tech Tests are invaluable to the development process. They help our team identify bugs, evaluate performance, and gather meaningful feedback from the community before the game officially launches. Now, you might be wondering: If Tech Tests are so important, why haven’t we held one since MLB The Show 23? That’s a fair question. Game development is challenging, and each year brings its own set of difficult decisions and competing priorities. Some of those decisions resulted in us not holding Tech Tests for the past few years. We appreciate your patience, passion, and continued support, and we’re looking forward to having you be part of the process again. We will provide more details on the Tech Test in the new year. There is still more ahead for MLB The Show 26 , and the time you spend playing can give you a head start in MLB The Show 27. Now & Later packs are coming back. Now & Later Packs contain items you can use now in MLB The Show 26, with the added bonus of allowing you to redeem The Show Packs “later” in MLB The Show 27 at no additional cost. Each Now & Later Pack you earn playing Diamond Dynasty Content in MLB The Show 26 on console will give out a Now & Later voucher that will automatically be redeemed into The Show Packs when logging into MLB The Show 27 on console during its standard release. Make sure you log into ‘27 with the same account you used to earn Now & Later Packs in ‘26. While that’s all for today, in the meantime, get a head start and start earning those Now & Later Packs in MLB The Show 26. We look forward to sharing more soon and are excited about what’s to come in 2027. In the meantime, for the latest MLB The Show news, head to TheShow.com , sign up for The Scouting Report , and follow our official social channels.

sources.text: Inclui o retorno dos pacotes Now & Later, estatísticas da comunidade de MLB The Show 26 e muito mais. Antes de nos aprofundarmos nas novas informações sobre o MLB The Show 27, vamos fazer uma retrospectiva. Ao refletirmos sobre 2026, dois aspectos se destacam acima de tudo: a incrível paixão e o apoio da comunidade do MLB The Show e a nossa necessidade de melhorar a comunicação e a resposta aos feedbacks da comunidade daqui para frente. Quer você jogue há décadas ou tenha se juntado a nós pela primeira vez este ano, você ajudou a tornar este mais um capítulo especial na história da nossa franquia. As suas histórias, feedbacks, criatividade e paixão nos lembram do motivo pelo qual fazemos o que fazemos. Não consideramos o seu tempo, a sua confiança ou o seu apoio como algo garantido, e somos extremamente afortunados por ter uma comunidade que se importa tanto com o jogo. Agora, você pode estar se perguntando: se os testes técnicos são tão importantes, por que não realizamos nenhum desde o MLB The Show 23? Essa é uma pergunta pertinente. O desenvolvimento de jogos é desafiador, e cada ano traz seu próprio conjunto de decisões difíceis e prioridades conflitantes. Algumas dessas decisões fizeram com que não realizássemos testes técnicos nos últimos anos. Agradecemos por sua paciência, dedicação e apoio contínuos, e estamos ansiosos para contar com a sua participação no processo mais uma vez. Forneceremos mais detalhes sobre o teste técnico no início do ano que vem. Ainda há muito mais por vir em MLB The Show 26 , e o tempo que você dedicar ao jogo pode lhe dar uma vantagem inicial em MLB The Show 27. Os pacotes Now & Later estão de volta. Os pacotes Now & Later contêm itens que você pode usar agora no MLB The Show 26, com o bônus adicional de poder resgatar os pacotes The Show posteriormente no MLB The Show 27 sem custos adicionais. Cada pacote Now & Later que você obtém jogando conteúdos da Diamond Dynasty no MLB The Show 26 no console te proporcionará um voucher Now & Later que será resgatado automaticamente como pacotes The Show quando você iniciar sessão no MLB The Show 27 no console durante seu lançamento padrão. Certifique-se de iniciar sua sessão no 27 com a mesma conta que usou para obter os pacotes Now & Later no 26. Isso é tudo por hoje! Enquanto isso, ganhe uma vantagem e comece a obter os pacotes Now & Later no MLB The Show 26. Estamos ansiosos para compartilhar mais informações em breve e entusiasmados com o que está por vir em 2027. Enquanto isso, para ficar por dentro das novidades mais recentes de MLB The Show, acesse TheShow.com , inscreva-se no The Scouting Report e acompanhe nossos canais oficiais nas redes sociais.

sources.title: GTA 6 could have released sooner, Rockstar leads admit, but there's no point rushing out "GTA 5.5"
sources.text: "They would never stop working on this game if they had the choice" Rob Nelson, co-studio head of Rockstar North and GTA 6 lead, has explained that the game took so long simply because the studio had the option to. I don't think I'm surprising anyone by saying that GTA 6 has taken quite a while to come out. It's been 13 years, two console generations, and four Doctor Who actors since GTA 5, and it's made GTA 6 the most-anticipated game of all-time. And considering the first 10 GTA games were released in just 12 years , it kind of puts things into perspective just how long it's been, which feels even weirder when you realise we're just about a day away before people in New Zealand start playing it. Speaking to The Guardian , Rockstar Games head of publishing Jennifer Kolbe adds that the devs "would never stop working on this game if they had the choice," with Nelson explaining, "it's really hard to close it down." He adds that with "a little bit of space from it, you can look at it objectively and go: 'I'm proud of what we've done.'" In the end, "it is being taken away from you." Nelson questions that if a developer had as many resources as Rockstar did, wouldn't they also go for the most ambitious game they could possibly make? He explains, "What we have grappled with is the transition from being limited by technical constraints to being limited by human resource constraints," adding, "You can keep going forever… People say you can throw money at the problem, and you can to an extent, but it's no guarantee of making something good." Kolbe adds, "They could have made GTA 5.5 and done it faster," but that “ultimately, that's not what they wanted." Nelson chimes in, "You have to take big swings. It can't be just more of the same." sources.text: "Don't let 210GB get between you and your league." Assuming you didn't just buy a PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X/S to play Grand Theft Auto 6 , your console's limited storage space is likely already strained, meaning tough choices may have to be made to make room for Rockstar's chonky 212GB crime game . In a move I don't remember seeing before, EA is asking players to spare Madden NFL 27 from the purge to free up console storage space. As spotted by Push Square , a desperate in-game message pops up when you launch the American Football game, pleading with you not to delete it. The message highlights 17th November as the date of a Madden NFL 27 update, though its styling, wording and choice of background seem to hint at GTA 6. "Don't delete!" it reads, as shared by Zirksee on X . "[Encrypted Signal] The target is locked. The crew is assembling for a high-stakes run. Await the signal from our insider on 11/17… do not leak this transmission." EA's language and intention, however, are much clearer in this post on X , which specifically references GTA 6's large file size in a cheeky way, seemingly promoting the same update. "Don't let 210GB get between you and your league," the post reads, clearly quoting GTA 6's file size . The update in question is fairly notable, adding a Madden 97 throwback with era-appropriate players, playbooks and what looks to be 16-bit visuals. Though it's obviously not related to GTA 6 in any way, it's easy to see why EA would fear a significant drop in players once Rockstar's game arrives, something other publishers are undoubtedly worried about. As part of a recent restructuring, EA laid off 400 employees , closed down BioWare , cancelled unannounced projects and revealed a refocusing on its core franchises and biggest monkey-makers. That includes EA Sports, of course, where a team is currently developing a game codenamed Project Gridiron, described as "a social-first open-world experience for our American Football team".
